title.narrative: Strengthen the EaP CSF and its role of in the Eastern Partnership policy development and implementationomy

description.narrative: In line with the 20 Eastern Partnership Deliverables for 2020 (linked to civil society), the proposed action will build on the achievements of the previous EC grant and further develop the EaP CSF into a valued stakeholder of the EaP policy who enriches the EaP agenda with the civil society priorities and pushes forward the reform process. The action will strengthen the EaP CSF institutionally via the support and capacitybuilding to the Working Groups and National Platforms and finalising the internal reform allowing it to improve its decisionmaking process and engage the membership base. The action provides the Forum with the mechanisms that will allow it to work with the EU and national authorities in the EaP countries utilising its unique position in the EaP architecture and promptly react to the dynamic situation in the region by developing policy positions, rigorous communication and advocacy. The proposed action will help the Forum to be a relevant channel for CSOs from the region to contribute to the policyshaping and policymaking processes within the frames of the EaP, strengthen their capacities for taking part in the structured dialogues and monitoring the reforms in the partner countries, and advocate for the better operation environment for the CSOs.
